title: Minimum Share of Return Charges Paid Up Front — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
**Risk schedule — up-front share of return charges.** A returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract with recent late charges pays a minimum share of its return charges (the excess mileage charge, the excess wear charge and the return fee billed for the return) with the return balance payment:

| Balloon late charges assessed in the 24 calendar months ending on the payment date | Minimum share of the return charges paid with the return balance payment |
|---|---|
| Two or more | At least 0.5 (half) |
| Exactly one | At least 0.35 |
| None | No minimum share |

The late charges counted are the balloon late charge entries dated in the window; a window of 24 calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than 24 whole calendar months before it.

*Hypothetical:* return charges of USD 1,000.00 with one late charge 20 months before the payment date: at least USD 350.00 of the return charges is paid with the return balance payment.
